name: Castelletto sul Lago - Schlössel
kurzbeschreibung: Castelletto sul Lago – Schlössel in Tirol Discover the charm of Tirol with a stay at Castelletto sul Lago, a cozy retreat nestled in the heart of the Alps.
beschreibung: The Castelletto sul Lago - Schlössel in Landeck treats its guests to an exquisite selection of regional and seasonal dishes. The cuisine combines traditional Tyrolean recipes with creative touches, creating a unique culinary experience. The cozy interior invites guests to linger, while attentive service ensures complete well-being. Particularly recommended is the homemade Tyrolean dumpling soup (Tiroler Knödelsuppe), wonderfully warming after a long day of hiking. In addition, the restaurant offers a carefully curated wine list featuring fine wines from South Tyrol and Austria. The focus is firmly on regional products from Tirol, sourced from selected local farms and producers.
